name: Comdek
summary: Perth computer sales + networks + ADSL/dialup + satellite comms provider (Comdek Ltd, by 2003); defunct.

events.details: COMDEK COMPUTERS (W.A.) PTY LTD ACN 059950337 registered 04 May 1993; renamed Comdek Limited 18 Apr 2002; Comdek Connect BN from 6 Mar 2001 (connectivity arm).
Administration 7 Mar 2006, receiver-manager 14 Mar 2006; renamed Resource Generation Limited Sep 2008. Comdek Connect BN cancelled 12 Apr 2004.
